description: ONE SNAPSHOT OF BOTH MARKETS, no arguments. Top instruments across crypto AND US stocks together, ranked by Martingale Score (0-5), with their Startingale readings: a general picture of both markets at once. crypto_overview and stock_overview cover a single asset class; search_instruments takes a count and filters. Answers in formatted text. Costs 10 units of the monthly quota, the highest cost of the seven tools, since it reads both catalogues; the single-class overviews cost half.
name: market_overview
title: Market overview
